capability.name: extract-metadata
capability.description: Extract document metadata including title, author, creation date, file size, and other properties

required.name: file_path
required.description: Path to the document file to process

optional.name: output
optional.description: Write output to specified file instead of stdout

response.description: Structured metadata including file properties, document properties, and format-specific metadata

FILE_NOT_FOUND.description: The specified file does not exist

UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT.description: The file format is not supported by this plugin

CORRUPTED_FILE.description: The file exists but cannot be parsed or is corrupted

PERMISSION_DENIED.description: Insufficient permissions to read the file
